articles.expand: It's a packed data agenda for the session here. I'll be mostly awaiting the Bank of Japan 'Summary'. The Bank of Japan's Summary of Opinions is a short document that collects the views expressed at a monetary policy meeting, published without naming who said what. It gives the market a read on the tone of the debate behind the decision, which the announcement itself doesn't show. Traders use it to judge how close the board is to another move.
